title: 63:1 Edom/Bozrah. In Hebrew, the consonants of Edom are the same as those in the word translated as red; the consonants of Bozrah may be interpreted as one who takes part in processing grapes into wine. (As a rule, Hebrew is written without vowels.) This parallel of red apparel and wine making is made even plainer in 63:2, in which we have the repetition of red and winevat.
author: Tina M. Peterson
